headline: Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley Vie for Anthropic IPO Mandate
summary: Anthropic named Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley as lead underwriters for its upcoming public offering, setting up the banks to compete for top advisory fees and prestige.
why: Leading high-profile initial public offerings generates substantial underwriting fees and enhances prestige for top-tier investment banks.

impacts.name: Goldman Sachs Group Inc
impacts.why: Securing a lead underwriting role on a major tech IPO increases advisory revenue potential.

impacts.name: Morgan Stanley
impacts.why: Securing a lead underwriting role on a major tech IPO increases advisory revenue potential.
